name: narik
description: Narik — game manajemen angkot dengan cerita (prototipe Bab 1–3)

scripts.assets: python3 tools/blender/build_textures.py assets/img && python3 tools/blender/build_assets.py assets/models && node tools/pack_models.js && python3 tools/blender/render_sprites.py assets/img
